summary: Service management in Business Central covers scheduling service calls, managing service orders and contracts, planning prices and statuses, delivering service, and analyzing service data. It answers how-to questions about the service flow from quote to invoice and about service reports. It is available only with the Premium experience.
overview:
Service Management gives service-oriented companies tools to schedule service calls, manage service orders, track repair parts, assign service personnel, and deliver estimates and invoices. It is available only with the Premium experience.

The section is split into four subtopics. Fulfill service contracts covers creating contracts and quotes and maintaining them. Planning service covers pricing, repair status, allocation status, and how order status follows item repair statuses. Deliver service walks through the work itself: quotes and orders, resource allocation, service tasks, loaners, posting, and invoicing. Service management analytics covers service statistics and service reports.

Start with the overview page to confirm the Premium requirement. Then follow the order that matches your task: contracts for recurring agreements, delivery for day-to-day service orders, planning for pricing and status questions, and analytics for reporting.
key_points: Service Management is available only with the Premium experience.
Core capabilities: schedule service calls, manage service orders, track repair parts, assign personnel, issue service estimates and invoices.
Fulfill service contracts: create contracts and contract quotes, manage contract lines and lifecycle, change annual amounts, and handle service items under multiple contracts.
Deliver service: create quotes and orders, allocate resources, work on service tasks, lend loaners, post, and invoice.
Planning service: service pricing, repair status, allocation status, and how service order status derives from item repair statuses.
Statuses change as work progresses or resources are reallocated.
Service management analytics: service statistics and a set of service reports for analyzing service documents and performance (38 pages).
